fact: The health ministry (MINSABSIS) says the DHIS2 pilot run in June 2025 in the Baney and Añisok health districts finished satisfactorily, with national expansion of DHIS2 foreseen for 2026.

UNDP reports the official launch at Baney on 1 March 2025 of the national health system's digital tool, the DHIS2 platform, giving the ministry district-level aggregated care data, with more than 100 digital agents trained.
EHAS says a first DHIS2 pilot ran from February to May 2025 in two districts, Baney and Añisok, where health facilities or district offices enter real data, centralised on a server at the ministry.
